description: This walk takes you from Skegness to the Gibraltar Point Nature Reserve on the Lincolnshire coast. It's an easy 3 mile walk to the reserve from the sea front in the town centre. As you leave the bustling seaside attractions of Skegness behind, the path transitions into a serene coastal landscape dominated by shifting sand dunes and expansive salt marshes. This stretch of the Lincolnshire Coastal Pathway offers bracing sea air and unobstructed views across the Wash. The terrain is largely level, making it an accessible route for families and casual walkers looking to trade the neon lights for natural beauty.The destination is a true sanctuary for outdoor enthusiasts. Gibraltar Point National Nature Reserve is world-renowned for its diverse habitats, which provide a vital pit-stop for thousands of migrating birds. Depending on the season, you might spot little terns nesting on the beach, skylarks soaring over the dunes, or impressive displays of wintering waders. With its modern visitor centre and winding boardwalks, the reserve provides a perfect peaceful contrast to the lively atmosphere of the town.
